config.stop: Exact first pin low (long) or high (short), owner confirmed
config.target: Near: long Monday low, short Monday high. Far: long Monday high, short Monday low. Original NY Monday anchor frozen for the trade; one full-size native limit.
config.holding: No elapsed expiry, no breakeven/partial/trailing; data boundary or unexpected crypto gap censored separately
config.fee_source: Owner AGENTS: OKX USDT perp Lv1 read-only account trade-fee. Applied as execution-cost scenario to Binance data; market entry/stop/censor taker, TP limit maker, actual fill notionals.
config.spot_fee: Unknown broker/spread; XAU gross only, net null. No OKX perp fee applied to spot.
config.owner_authorization: 2026-10-24 owner answered: test both near and far targets. Keep current case3 body-confirmation rule and prior authorized N1..5.
config.baseline: Frozen current body-rule N1..5 near-target entries, control times and outcomes. No strict-wick rule included.
config.gold: Corrected local NY clock and existing conflict exclusions; case2 unavailable because volume is zero.
config.execution: Independent one-base-unit columns; O-H-L-C monotone segments, native stop-market open-gap prices, fixed limit target; exact next-open entry, same candle exits allowed.
config.selection: Independently select N1..5 within each target policy on pre2023 meanR; evaluate later. No joint best-of10 adoption. Exclude each position crossing2023 from split metrics; label previously researched history.
config.validation: Later unchanged historical segment, no fresh holdout claim; matched random controls and Holm correction across selected later comparisons.
config.reuse: Near executions and excursions reused verbatim. New far unique geometries execute once through existing VectorBT adapter.
limitations: Independent trades are not a funded portfolio. Overlap and simultaneous directions retained.

Farther targets can create more unresolved positions. All closed-cohort means are accompanied by censor counts and both-resolved target comparisons.
config.signal: 1h first weekly touch per direction, pin body strictly inside. Subsequent N full consecutive hourly bodies at/inside original1.618; wicks unrestricted. Enter next5m open after all confirmations close.
config.controls: Same random entry times/stops/volatility buckets as each near baseline. Far random TP has the signal far reward distance as a fraction of entry. Three closed controls required for paired statistics.
config.excursion: Retrospective O-H-L-C path through native exit segment/fill only; no post-exit extremes. Report prior-exit-bar lower bound. MFE>0 is gross; estimated net MFE assumes taker liquidation. Thresholds0.5/1/2R are diagnostics only.
config.cohort: Identical entries across targets. Original candidates beyond the near TP were rejected and are not added. No minimum-RR/cost filter. Target comparisons include both-closed subset plus unresolved counts.
